subject: Sequence Labeling
source_sentence: Sequence labeling models are built on a recurrent neural network to sequentially go through a source text and learn the likelihood of each word in the source text to be a keyphrase word.

subject: Multi-task Learning
object: extract keyphrases from the source text
source_sentence: We propose a multi-task learning framework which simultaneously learns to extract keyphrases from the source text and generate keyphrases word by word with external knowledge.
